description: This source file defines the PreviewLauncherActivity class, which is an Android activity used as a developer helper to launch a rating screen with predefined RatingInfo data. It is not part of the main app flow but is used for testing or internal purposes.

classes.name: PreviewLauncherActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that, upon creation, immediately launches a rating info screen with hardcoded data, and then finishes itself.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides AppCompatActivity's onCreate to set up the activity, create a RatingInfo object, start the rating activity with that info, and finish itself.
